subject: Hosted API headroom add-on and tier shift request
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan@fluxretail.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@fluxretail.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term headroom + commit shift for Q3 spike

Hi Sergio,

Quick context: Flux is seeing an unexpected 3x increase in recommendation traffic for a new vendor integration slated for late June. We don’t want to hit throttles mid-launch. Procurement asked me to request a short-term headroom add-on and explore moving to a higher monthly commit tier with a 60-day notice so we have predictable pricing.

Ask: can Redwood provide a one-month headroom add-on (temporary pool of extra tokens) and a path to shift our monthly commit from 1.5M tokens to 4M tokens with adjusted rate bands? We’re open to a temporary prorated invoice + a brief SLA note on burst protection.

I attached our internal usage projection (Flux_Headroom_Request_v3.pdf). Happy to hop on a short call this week.

Thanks,
Evan Brooks
Head of Integrations, Flux Retail
[Attachment: Flux_Headroom_Request_v3.pdf (application/pdf), 128KB]

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term headroom + commit shift for Q3 spike

Evan — really appreciate the heads-up and the projection doc. This is exactly the kind of seasonal surge planning we like to catch early.

Short answer: yes — we can provision a temporary headroom pool and propose a staged commit uplift with a 60-day effective window. I’ve looped Karthik (pricing/commits) and Marissa (legal & billing ops) to scope a clean proposal.

Proposed immediate steps (mutual action plan):
- Sergio: draft headroom add-on and a two-option commit path (one-time 1-month headroom + step to 4M/month OR 2-month phased uplift).
- Karthik: confirm rateband delta for 1.5M -> 4M and calculate prorated month invoice + any introductory discount.
- Marissa: review billing cadence and prepare amendment language for a 60-day effective term and burst protection clause.
- Evan: confirm preferred go-live date and whether procurement needs PO/DocuSign link.

I’ll attach a working rateband spreadsheet for ops (redwood_rateband_proposal.xlsx). Can you do a quick call Wednesday 10:00am PT?

Best,

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding Evan’s note and the projection. TL;DR: Flux wants a short-term headroom pool and to bump their monthly commit to 4M tokens.

Karthik — can you run the delta math and propose: (A) a single-month headroom add-on price and (B) new monthly unit rates for the 4M tier (and the intermediate 2.5M stepped option)? Highlight any SLA/latency notes we should call out for burst protection.

Marissa — if we go to 60-day effective, procurement will want a one-line amendment and DocuSign. Any legal concerns with a temporary burst clause that guarantees priority routing for a capped amount?

Notes from Evan’s projection: peak days hitting ~7x normal qps for ~10 days, sustained +3x for the month. They’ll likely need consistent KV caching and prefix reuse to keep unit costs reasonable.

Thanks — need a short turn on pricing so I can get back to Evan before Wednesday call.

Hi Evan — thanks again for the projection and the call earlier. Following up with the formal proposal and next steps.

Outcome summary (proposal):
1) Headroom add-on: one-time 1-month headroom pool of 1.8M tokens (applies only to June 2027 window). Fee: $4,900 (prorated for June launch). Headroom includes priority routing up to the headroom cap; standard SLOs continue beyond that point.
2) Commit shift (option A - immediate): move monthly committed tokens from 1.5M -> 4M with a 60-day notice. New unit rate for 4M tier: $0.0009/token for generation, $0.00018/token for embeddings (rateband table attached). We included a 6% volume discount for the first 3 months.
3) Commit shift (option B - phased): 2.5M for 30 days, then 4M after 30 more days. Prorated invoicing and a one-time migration credit of $1,500 to offset partial month churn.

Billing & contract mechanics:
- Amendment: 60-day effective window; we’ll send an Amendment + DocuSign link once Flux confirms option A or B and PO number.
- Invoicing: headroom fee billed immediately (prorated), commit uplift reflected on the first invoice after the effective date.
- SLA: we will add a short burst-protection clause that guarantees prioritized routing for requests covered by the headroom pool. This does not change uptime SLA but establishes a temporary priority lane for capped traffic.

Attachments: redwood_rateband_proposal.xlsx (rates & math), Amendment_Draft_Flux_v1.docx (term language).

Next steps for Flux: confirm option (A or B), confirm go-live date (preferred: 2027-06-15), provide PO number if procurement needs it. I’ve added the DocuSign link below for the Amendment draft; we can also walk procurement through the clause if they want a short legal call.

DocuSign (Amendment draft): https://docusign.com/link/FLX-AMEND-2027
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

If you confirm today we can lock the headroom pool and get provisioning ready for 6/15.

Best,
